---
title: "Techne Fall 2026"
---

This project highlights a compact election analysis for the 2026 cycle using a small dataset of state-level vote totals.

## Overview

- Compare total votes by party
- Review state-by-state vote totals
- Identify the closest races in the sample

The analysis page summarizes the results and includes clear charts for easy comparison. Use the navigation bar to explore the full report or read more about the project.
